help.menu:
YipYap help

Available in chat:
YipYap help — Show this menu; no account connection needed.
YipYap status — Check this host's connection and teaching readiness.
yip new — Personal words from the last seven days, split into last 24 hours and earlier.
yip new day — Personal words from the last 24 hours.
yip new week — Personal words from the last seven days, in one group.
yip summary — Personal My Lexicon counts, not learning scores.
Status can report Not set up or Unavailable; vocabulary reads require an available authorized connection.
YipYap update status — Check the signed update channel only where the trusted updater is available; does not install an update.

Complete in the YipYap app:
YipYap on / YipYap off — Learning Mode; chat provides guidance only.
set_level <0..8> / level_up / level_down — Stored level; chat provides guidance only.
Account connection, disconnection, language selection and account settings use the app's controls or setup walkthrough.

Unavailable:
more / less / pause — Await the account-session contract.
Levels 9 and 10 — Await the teaching contract.

Use each command as a separate message, exactly as shown.
Example: YipYap status
Example: yip new day
Existing LL, Yip-Yap and Yip Yap status/mode aliases retain their original behavior; they do not create help aliases.
